title: This Fish Watches the Sky and the Water at the Same Time
subject: four-eyed fish

scenes.text: This fish watches the sky and the water at the same time.
It swims right at the surface, and a bird above is hunting it.
Each of its two eyes is split in half, with two pupils and two corneas.
The top half is built for air. The bottom half is built for water.
Its lens is thicker at the bottom, because seeing through water needs a thicker lens.
So it spots birds above and food below, at once. It even mates left to right.

description:
A four-eyed fish watches the sky and the water at the same time.
Each eye is split in two, with two pupils and two corneas, so one half sees in air and the other under water. Its lens is thicker at the bottom for vision through water.
Would you want eyes like that?
first_comment: Males and females are either left-handed or right-handed, and a right-handed male can only mate with a left-handed female. Which fish would you rather be?
